items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The first time I heard Zutty in person was when he was with Roy Eldridge at the Three Deuces in Chicago. You see, I was with Don Redman at that time... Reynald Jones, he was Roy's cousin, and we used to get off from the Regal Theater and we used to go down there and jam

ctx.x: Yeah, Teddy. Who else was in? Anybody else you remember?
Sure. The trumpet section was Reynauld Jones and Steve Dunn from Cincinnati and Roy Eldridge.
